payload.title: the close report has no sender and no restatement
payload.body: Ruled: both are realization gaps of concepts already settled. The architect role reads the planner's report that a plan has closed and the names of units waiting on a route; the planner is the one that sends them, so the planner role's contract states that it returns those, and the architect role cell's archetype names the closed-plan route beside the unit routes. Added to notebook-gaps: shard planner role.
